locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Los Angeles International Airport
locations.description: YYZ departs 08:30 → LAX arrives 10:55 AM. Backpack travel — no baggage claim wait; straight through arrivals to lower level for rental car shuttle.

locations.name: 🚗 LAX Rental Car Center (TBD)
locations.description: ⚠️ Rental car details TBD — booking not confirmed yet. Process: follow pink LAX Shuttle signs on arrivals level → free shuttle to LAX Rental Car Center, 5251 W 98th St (new facility, opened Mar 2026) → pick up at counter. Allow 45–60 min buffer from landing to driving. Bring: Canadian driver's licence + credit card + booking confirmation. Say NO to: FasTrak add-on (zero tolls on your routes) and extra insurance if credit card covers it.

locations.name: 🏨 Hollywood City Inn
locations.description: 1615 North Western Avenue, Hollywood, CA 90027. Check-in from 3:00 PM — drop backpacks at front desk and head out. Free parking. 0.9 mi (~18 min walk) to Hollywood Walk of Fame.

locations.name: 🚢 Crossroads of the World
locations.description: 6671 Sunset Blvd, Hollywood — quirky 1936 Art Deco landmark shaped like a ship's prow with a spinning globe on top, surrounded by small cottage-style buildings. One of LA's most photographed oddities. 5-min stop, free to view from outside.

locations.name: 🏰 Chateau Marmont
locations.description: 8221 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood — legendary Gothic Revival hotel built in 1929; one of Hollywood's most storied celebrity retreats. Photograph the dramatic ivy-draped facade from Sunset Blvd. Quick drive-by or park and snap.

locations.name: 🎸 Whisky a Go Go
locations.description: 8901 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood — legendary rock club opened 1964; The Doors, Led Zeppelin, Alice Cooper and countless others played here. Quick photo of the iconic marquee sign on the Sunset Strip.

locations.name: 🌟 Hollywood Blvd – Evening Walk
locations.description: Hotel is 0.9 mi from the Walk of Fame — stroll over for a first look at the stars and TCL Chinese Theatre forecourt at night. Good warm-up before the full Day 3 sightseeing loop.

locations.name: 🍔 In-N-Out Burger – Sunset Blvd
locations.description: 7009 Sunset Blvd, Hollywood — ~5 min drive from hotel. Drive-thru + dine-in. Open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM – 1:00 AM · Fri–Sat 10:30 AM – 1:30 AM. Classic Double-Double, Animal Style fries. Location page

days.title: ZIPANGU Festival at the Rose Bowl

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel – Leisurely Morning
locations.description: Leisurely breakfast near the hotel; rest up and charge up for the big night ahead

locations.name: 🎵 ZIPANGU Festival – Brookside at the Rose Bowl
locations.description: First major Japanese music festival on US soil! Lineup: Ado ★ Headliner (~1 hr closing set inside the iconic Ado Box) · ATARASHII GAKKO! · MAN WITH A MISSION · CHANMINA · HANA · 10-FEET · Yuki Chiba. Doors: 3:30 PM · First acts: ~4:00 PM · Ado closes: ~10:00 PM. Capacity ~35,000. Organizer: Cloud Nine × Goldenvoice (Coachella organizers). Getting there: Uber/Lyft ~30 min from Hollywood. Official Site

locations.name: 🚗 Drive Back to Hotel
locations.description: Walk ~1.5 mi (~20 min) from venue back to Parsons Parking Lot, Old Town Pasadena — away from the crowd surge. Then drive back to Hollywood City Inn (~25 min). Road traffic near the venue will have eased by the time you reach the car.

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel Breakfast
locations.description: Last morning in Hollywood — breakfast near the hotel before the sightseeing loop

locations.name: 🎬 Egyptian Theatre
locations.description: 6712 Hollywood Blvd — Hollywood's first movie palace (1922), designed in Egyptian Revival style with hieroglyphic-decorated forecourt and colonnade. Now operated by Netflix as a premiere venue. Quick exterior photo stop.

locations.name: 🍽️ Musso & Frank Grill
locations.description: 6667 Hollywood Blvd — Hollywood's oldest restaurant, open since 1919. The red-and-black awning and vintage neon sign make for a great photo. Regulars over the years included Charlie Chaplin, Raymond Chandler, and Hunter S. Thompson.

locations.name: 🎭 El Capitan Theatre
locations.description: 6838 Hollywood Blvd — Disney's ornate 1941 historic premiere theatre with a colourful Spanish Colonial Revival facade. Typically has themed window displays tied to current Disney releases. Right across from TCL Chinese Theatre.

locations.name: 🏛️ Hollywood & Highland – Babylon Court
locations.description: 6801 Hollywood Blvd at Highland Ave — the giant open-air Babylon Court arch perfectly frames the Hollywood Sign in the hills. Best photo: stand at the base of the steps looking up through the arch toward the hills. Also home to the Dolby Theatre (Oscars venue). Free to enter and explore.

locations.name: 🏨 Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel
locations.description: 7000 Hollywood Blvd — built in 1927, hosted the very first Academy Awards ceremony in 1929. Stunning Spanish Colonial exterior with the neon Roosevelt sign. Located right next to TCL Chinese Theatre. Quick exterior photo.

locations.name: 🗿 Madame Tussauds Hollywood
locations.description: 6933 Hollywood Blvd — life-size celebrity figure displays are visible from the street before the building opens. Free photo ops at street level without buying a ticket.

locations.name: ⭐ Hollywood Walk of Fame
locations.description: Stroll Hollywood Blvd and spot celebrity stars embedded in the sidewalk. Early morning means fewer crowds and great photos.

locations.name: 🎬 TCL Chinese Theatre
locations.description: Iconic Hollywood landmark — see celebrity handprints and footprints cast in concrete in the forecourt. Free to browse outside; open from 8 AM. More info

locations.name: 💿 Capitol Records Building
locations.description: 1750 N Vine St, Hollywood — the iconic circular tower designed to look like a stack of records with a stylus on top. Opened 1956; Frank Sinatra, Nat King Cole, and The Beatles all recorded here. Short walk east from TCL Chinese Theatre, then south on Vine.

locations.name: 🎭 Hollywood Pantages Theatre
locations.description: 6233 Hollywood Blvd, near Hollywood & Vine — quick photo stop. Stunning Art Deco exterior built in 1930; one of LA's most beautiful historic theatres. Free to admire and photograph outside. More info

locations.name: 🎬 Lake Hollywood Park – Hollywood Sign View
locations.description: Weidlake Dr, Hollywood Hills — the best close-up Hollywood Sign viewpoint without any hiking. Park on Weidlake Dr (free street parking); the sign looms directly above the reservoir. ~15 min drive from Hollywood Blvd. Go before noon to beat crowds.

locations.name: 🔭 Griffith Observatory
locations.description: ~15 min drive from Lake Hollywood; free admission; sweeping panoramic LA views with the Hollywood Sign in the backdrop. Official Site

locations.name: 🍔 Lunch near Hotel
locations.description: Last meal in LA; many options on Hollywood Blvd and surrounding streets

locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Departure to Toronto (YYZ)
locations.time: Leave 7:15 PM · Return car 8:00 PM · 22:35 flight
locations.description: Leave last stop by 7:15 PM → drive ~35–40 min → arrive LAX Rental Car Center by 8:00 PM → return car (~10 min) → free shuttle to terminal (~8:30 PM) → mobile check-in + TSA security → at gate by ~9:15 PM. Gate closes ~10:05 PM. Flight departs 22:35 → YYZ arrives Mon 06:24 (Victoria Day 🇨🇦).
